stanzas.sanskrit:
मदनातुरचेतसोऽन्वहं
भवदङ्घ्रिद्वयदास्यकाम्यया ।
यमुनातटसीम्नि सैकतीं
तरलाक्ष्यो गिरिजां समार्चिचन् ॥ ६०-१ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: With the desire to serve Krishna's lotus feet every day, the gopikas made an image of Goddess Girja on sand near the banks of river Yamuna and worshipped her devotionally.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
madanāturacetaso’nvahaṃ
bhavadaṅghridvayadāsyakāmyayā |
yamunātaṭasīmni saikatīṃ
taralākṣyo girijāṃ samārcican || 60-1 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
तव नामकथारताः समं
सुदृशः प्रातरुपागता नदीम् ।
उपहारशतैरपूजयन्
दयितो नन्दसुतो भवेदिति ॥ ६०-२ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: The beautiful gopikas were always immersed in chanting Bhagwan’s name and narrating His deeds. In the morning they would go to the river and worship goddess Girijaa with hundreds of offerings and pray to her that Krishna, should become their husband.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
tava nāmakathāratāḥ samaṃ
sudṛśaḥ prātarupāgatā nadīm |
upahāraśatairapūjayan
dayito nandasuto bhavediti || 60-2 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
इति मासमुपाहितव्रता-
-स्तरलाक्षीरभिवीक्ष्य ता भवान् ।
करुणामृदुलो नदीतटं
समयासीत्तदनुग्रहेच्छया ॥ ६०-३ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Krishna was touched by compassion, when he saw the gopikas performing the vratha for a month. He went to the river bank to bless them.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
iti māsamupāhitavratā-
-staralākṣīrabhivīkṣya tā bhavān |
karuṇāmṛdulo nadītaṭaṃ
samayāsīttadanugrahecchayā || 60-3 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
नियमावसितौ निजाम्बरं
तटसीमन्यवमुच्य तास्तदा ।
यमुनाजलखेलनाकुलाः
पुरतस्त्वामवलोक्य लज्जिताः ॥ ६०-४ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Having completed the vratha for a month, the gopikas went to the river to play in the water happily, leaving behind their clothes on the river bank. When they saw Krishna there, they felt ashamed.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
niyamāvasitau nijāmbaraṃ
taṭasīmanyavamucya tāstadā |
yamunājalakhelanākulāḥ
puratastvāmavalokya lajjitāḥ || 60-4 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
त्रपया नमिताननास्वथो
वनितास्वम्बरजालमन्तिके ।
निहितं परिगृह्य भूरुहो
विटपं त्वं तरसाऽधिरूढवान् ॥ ६०-५ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Gopikas put their heads down in shame. Krishna took away the heap of clothes lying on the river bank and climbed up the branch of a tree.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
trapayā namitānanāsvatho
vanitāsvambarajālamantike |
nihitaṃ parigṛhya bhūruho
viṭapaṃ tvaṃ tarasā’dhirūḍhavān || 60-5 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
इह तावदुपेत्य नीयतां
वसनं वः सुदृशो यथायथम् ।
इति नर्ममृदुस्मिते त्वयि
ब्रुवति व्यामुमुहे वधूजनैः ॥ ६०-६ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Krishna with a teasing smile, asked the gopikas to come and take their clothes. Gopikas became helpless and more embarrassed at this and were confused as to what to do.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
iha tāvadupetya nīyatāṃ
vasanaṃ vaḥ sudṛśo yathāyatham |
iti narmamṛdusmite tvayi
bruvati vyāmumuhe vadhūjanaiḥ || 60-6 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
अयि जीव चिरं किशोर न-
-स्तव दासीरवशीकरोषि किम् ।
प्रदिशाम्बरमम्बुजेक्षणे-
-त्युदितस्त्वं स्मितमेव दत्तवान् ॥ ६०-७ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: With folded hands they pleaded Krishna as to why He is doing this to them, who are His servants and requested Him to give back their clothes. Krishna gave an attractive smile as an answer.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
ayi jīva ciraṃ kiśora na-
-stava dāsīravaśīkaroṣi kim |
pradiśāmbaramambujekṣaṇe-
-tyuditastvaṃ smitameva dattavān || 60-7 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
अधिरुह्य तटं कृताञ्जलीः
परिशुद्धाः स्वगतीर्निरीक्ष्य ताः ।
वसनान्यखिलान्यनुग्रहं
पुनरेवं गिरमप्यदा मुदा ॥ ६०-८ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Krishna saw that the Gopikas who came out of the water with folded hands and prayed were purified at heart and surrendering. Krishna with joy gave them back all their clothes and also words of promise as blessings.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
adhiruhya taṭaṃ kṛtāñjalīḥ
pariśuddhāḥ svagatīrnirīkṣya tāḥ |
vasanānyakhilānyanugrahaṃ
punarevaṃ giramapyadā mudā || 60-8 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
विदितं ननु वो मनीषितं
वदितारस्त्विह योग्यमुत्तरम् ।
यमुनापुलिने सचन्द्रिकाः
क्षणदा इत्यबलास्त्वमूचिवान् ॥ ६०-९ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Krishna said that He knows the minds of gopikas and would give a proper response during the moon lit nights on the sand banks of the river Yamuna at an appropriate time.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
viditaṃ nanu vo manīṣitaṃ
vaditārastviha yogyamuttaram |
yamunāpuline sacandrikāḥ
kṣaṇadā ityabalāstvamūcivān || 60-9 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
उपकर्ण्य भवन्मुखच्युतं
मधुनिष्यन्दि वचो मृगीदृशः ।
प्रणयादयि वीक्ष्य वीक्ष्य ते
वदनाब्जं शनकैर्गृहं गताः ॥ ६०-१० ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Gopikas heard the honey dripping words of Krishna. They saw his lotus face again and again with love and slowly returned to their respective houses.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
upakarṇya bhavanmukhacyutaṃ
madhuniṣyandi vaco mṛgīdṛśaḥ |
praṇayādayi vīkṣya vīkṣya te
vadanābjaṃ śanakairgṛhaṃ gatāḥ || 60-10 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
इति नन्वनुगृह्य वल्लवी-
-र्विपिनान्तेषु पुरेव सञ्चरन् ।
करुणाशिशिरो हरे हर
त्वरया मे सकलामयावलिम् ॥ ६०-११ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en:
After blessing the Gopikas, Krishna roamed in the forest. Bhattathiri pleased with Gopika's devotion and Krishna's mercy on them, requested Bhagwan to put an end to all his ailments.

Gopi vasthraapaharanam explanations.... Mam audio gave ...
stanzas.stanza_roman:
iti nanvanugṛhya vallavī-
-rvipinānteṣu pureva sañcaran |
karuṇāśiśiro hare hara
tvarayā me sakalāmayāvalim || 60-11 ||
